body:
## Quick answer

You can buy Indian clothes online from **Bahe Kurtiz** in Jaipur and have them delivered to the UK with **free express shipping and duties included** – nothing extra to pay on delivery. Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and arrive about 5–10 business days later; every style can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost.

## Sizes in UK

UK dress sizes are 4 higher than US sizes: UK 12 is about a 36-inch bust (an Indian M). The [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) has a UK option, or choose free custom fit.

## What to wear in UK

British weather means layers for most of the year: velvet or taffeta Anarkalis for winter weddings and Diwali, thermals under straight pants, and a long coat or shawl over the dupatta. In summer, cotton and georgette are enough.

## Festivals and wedding season

Big Diwali celebrations take place in cities such as Leicester and London, and Vaisakhi is celebrated by Sikh communities across the UK every April. Indian weddings run all year, with many in the summer. See the exact last order dates for upcoming festivals below and on our [festival calendar](/festival/).

faq.q: How long does delivery to the UK take?
faq.a: Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and custom-fit pieces in 10–15 working days; express delivery then takes about 5–10 business days, with tracking.

faq.q: Will I pay customs duty in the UK?
faq.a: No. We ship duties-paid (DDP), so duties and taxes are included and there is nothing to pay on delivery.

faq.q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.a: Prices are in US dollars. Your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts it to pounds.

faq.q: What if my size is not standard?
faq.a: Choose free custom fit and send your bust, waist, hip and height – we stitch the outfit to your measurements at no extra cost, up to size 3XL (4XL in our linen & velvet styles).
